verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official CLI, nitropy, with a dedicated docs page. A runtime probe confirmed it installs keylessly from PyPI (`uvx --from pynitrokey nitropy version`) and identifies itself as the 'Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices' (v0.13.0). Missing for 10: detailed evidence of command coverage across device features, and AI/agent-friendly traits such as machine-readable (JSON) output or non-interactive scripting docs.
